name: Sewer Rats
source:
In a dystopian future on the brink of civil war with robot overlords, you play as a determined teen eager to attend a secret rave with your friends. As you navigate government surveillance, class differences, and family secrets, your friendships are tested. The rave becomes a pivotal moment where you must confront the truth about your world and make a choice that will determine the fate of your friend, all while grappling with the fundamental question of humanity's nature: are we good or evil?

[From [url=https://charitydoesgames.itch.io/sewer-rats]itch.io[/url]]
